    • Result: Mexico 16, Brazil 0 (6 innings).
    • Significance: This victory was tied for the third-largest margin in World Baseball Classic history.
    • Top Performers: Alejandro Kirk delivered a key three-run homer in the fourth inning.
    • Venue: Daikin Park, Houston, TX. 
    Other recent matchups, such as a April 2026 "Legends" match, saw a closer competition (Mexico 3-2 Brazil).
